swap_scope: Global host deltas include unrelated services; process/cgroup swap tracked separately. No attribution to model from global counters alone.
memory_scope: Charged cgroup memory includes reclaimable file cache. Process PSS and anon/file recorded separately. Tiny observed cgroup limit overshoots are reported, not hidden. Driver/shared accounting is not proven solely by the cap.
load_scope: Full model SHA read warms OS cache; download already complete before this pilot. Ambient host services and separate CPU-only preflights are uncontrolled. Matched explicit-loading-mode IQ3/Q4 resource observations, not a quantization-only causal speed comparison or agent-quality result.
memory_components_note: file includes shared-memory buffers as well as reclaimable cache; independent peak columns occur at different times and must not be summed.
